SELECT
  date_trunc('$interval', m.created_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS "Созвонов"
FROM meetings.meetings m
WHERE m.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  COALESCE(u.name, u.username, m.mentor_telegram_id::text) AS mentor,
  COUNT(*) AS meetings
FROM meetings.meetings m
JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = m.mentor_telegram_id
WHERE m.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND m.mentor_telegram_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY mentor
ORDER BY meetings DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  COALESCE(c.value, 'Без стадии') AS stage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS meetings
FROM meetings.meetings m
LEFT JOIN integrations.user_cohorts uc ON uc.user_telegram_id = m.student_telegram_id
LEFT JOIN integrations.cohorts c ON c.id = uc.cohort_id AND c.type = 'Status'
WHERE m.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY c.value
ORDER BY meetings DESC

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    m.mentor_telegram_id,
    date_trunc('week', m.created_at) AS week,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM meetings.meetings m
  WHERE m.mentor_telegram_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS "Ментор",
  ROUND(AVG(w.cnt), 1) AS "Среднее в неделю",
  SUM(w.cnt) AS "Всего"
FROM weekly w
JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = w.mentor_telegram_id
GROUP BY u.name, u.username
ORDER BY "Среднее в неделю" DESC
